principles: Only document and fix real correctness or consistency issues.
Separate local Lattice CLI Non-authority evidence from Authority Server proof.
Mark future Layer4 capability as future/blocked instead of implying current implementation.
Keep the execution plan small and auditable.
drivers: Current gap_analyze high findings must not be fake-resolved.
User explicitly wants future capability prose adjusted to future/blocked scope.
The story must follow Lattice lifecycle with two-host audit evidence.

options.name: A: Write a narrow execution plan and future/blocked Layer4 note
pros: Creates a clear follow-up path for the signed workspace consistency gaps.
cons: Does not make convergence green by itself.
Requires a later implementation story if the signed workspace gaps prove real code/doc drift.

options.name: B: Implement customerKeyRef and all gap fixes now
pros: Could eventually remove more gap_analyze findings in one wave.
cons: Violates the user choice to mark future capability as future/blocked.
Would expand into Layer4 Production Safety without a dedicated unlock story.
Risks arbitrary optimization and false capability claims.

options.name: C: Only mark F-009 resolved without new evidence
pros: Fastest way to reduce visible backlog text.
cons: Would weaken the no false DONE/no false claim discipline.

chosen: A: Write a narrow execution plan and future/blocked Layer4 note
rationale: Option A is the only option that satisfies the requested scope while preserving Host Neutral, Non-authority, and no-false-claim boundaries.

preMortem.scenario: The document accidentally claims Layer2 or Layer4 unlock.
preMortem.trigger: Wording says PASS, unlocked, production-ready, or receipt verified without formal artifacts.
preMortem.consequence: Future agents may treat local docs work as capability proof.
preMortem.mitigation: Include explicit non-goals and DONE criteria stating no capability unlock occurs from this document alone.

preMortem.scenario: customerKeyRef is implemented or described as current behavior without a Layer4 story.
preMortem.trigger: The edit changes code or current contract fields instead of marking future/blocked scope.
preMortem.consequence: Production safety boundary becomes inconsistent and overclaims Authority capability.
preMortem.mitigation: Limit this story to future/blocked wording and require a separate Layer4 implementation story for real customerKeyRef support.

preMortem.scenario: The signed workspace gaps are dismissed without checking reality.
preMortem.trigger: The execution plan labels them documentation-only without confirming code/doc relation.
preMortem.consequence: A real correctness issue could remain hidden behind prose.
preMortem.mitigation: Document exact triage steps, commands, and acceptance criteria for a follow-up story to verify code output, docs wording, and process fact coverage.
